Bleed is a Damage Over Time Status inflicted as an On Hit Effect or by some Skills.

## Contents

- 1 Description

- 2 Known Modifiers

- 2.1 Character Stats

- 3 Affixes

- 4 Equipment

## Description[]

Bleed deals Physical Damage over 3 seconds. An enemy can have multiple instance of bleed at once.

The base bleed damage is 53 (over 3 seconds). This damage is further modified by Increased Damage, Increased Physical Damage and Increased Damage Over Time.
